<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Electoral alliances:</strong> Ahead of the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections, the Congress party is seeking a significant seat share, though alliance partners remain cautious regarding their political strength.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-_?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W10</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>EU-India relations:</strong> The EU Ambassador has called for a strengthened strategic agenda as New Delhi prepares to host a European Parliament delegation later this month.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a> <a href="https://news.google.-?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a></span></li>
